_schema: Read by app.html's loadCommerceOffers(). players is keyed by playerOfferId(ab,player) = '<team-abbrev-lowercase>-<slugified-player-name>' (see playerSlug() in app.html), e.g. 'chi-caleb-williams'. teams is keyed by the team abbreviation lowercased, e.g. 'bal'. Each key maps to {fanatics:[offer, ...]}. An offer only renders (and only becomes clickable) once it exists here with a real url - no placeholder/guessed offer is ever added on your behalf.

_offerFields.title: string - product name shown on the card
_offerFields.image: string|null - product image URL OR a local CardStorm asset path (e.g. 'assets/fanatics/nyg-jaxson-dart-limited-royal.webp'). NOT required for an offer to render or be clickable - when null, the card shows a deliberate CardStorm merchandise-pending visual (shirt-outline icon + 'OFFICIAL FANATICS GEAR' label) instead of a broken image or a fake product photo. Never guess this field.
_offerFields.imageSource: string|omit - where the image came from when present, e.g. 'Fanatics'. Independent of the offer's own 'source' field.
_offerFields.imageVerifiedDate: YYYY-MM-DD|omit - when the image itself was confirmed to be the correct exact product photo. Image verification is a separate step from offer (URL/title/price) verification - an offer can be fully live with imageVerifiedDate still unset.
_offerFields.url: string - the exact supplied Fanatics product URL, opened as-is by openCommerceOffer(), never rewritten or guessed
_offerFields.price: string - current price as supplied, e.g. '$129.99'
_offerFields.salePrice: string|omit - sale price as supplied; when present it's shown next to a struck-through price
_offerFields.team: string - team full name, for display/event logging only
_offerFields.player: string|omit - player full name, for display/event logging only (omit on team-level offers)
_offerFields.collection: string|omit - e.g. 'ROOKIE COLLECTION', shown as a small label above the title. Only set when the source itself labels the product this way - never inferred.
_offerFields.source: string - where this offer came from, e.g. 'Fanatics official product page'
_offerFields.lastChecked: YYYY-MM-DD|omit - most recent availability/price re-check, separate from lastVerified and imageVerifiedDate
_offerFields.status: internal, not shown to users - LIVE_VERIFIED (url/title/price/image all confirmed) | URL_VERIFIED_PRICE_VERIFIED_IMAGE_PENDING (url/title/price confirmed, no verified image yet - current normal state for a new offer) | REVIEW_REQUIRED (a discrepancy was found and needs human review) | INACTIVE (offer no longer available - excluded from Gear Up by isActiveOffer() in app.html, but the record stays here for audit history, never auto-deleted)

_dedupRule: url is the strongest duplicate key. Before adding a new offer, check it against every existing offer's url (then player+title, then team+title) across both players and teams - never render/store the same exact offer twice. A future price/status update to an existing offer should edit that offer's record in place (updating price/salePrice/lastChecked) rather than appending a duplicate.
